input.sql:
WITH gross AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category, date_trunc('quarter', o.completed_at) AS q, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.completed_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.completed_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), refunded AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category, date_trunc('quarter', r.refunded_at) AS q, SUM(r.amount * oi.unit_price * oi.quantity / ot.total) AS amount
  FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
  JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) ot ON ot.order_id = o.id
  WHERE r.refunded_at >= '2026-04-01' AND r.refunded_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT g.category, to_char(g.q, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS quarter, ROUND(g.amount - COALESCE(f.amount, 0), 0) AS net_revenue
FROM gross g LEFT JOIN refunded f USING (category, q)
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH gross AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category, date_trunc('quarter', o.completed_at) AS q, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS amount
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.completed_at >= '2026-04-01' AND o.completed_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), refunded AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category, date_trunc('quarter', r.refunded_at) AS q, SUM(r.amount * oi.unit_price * oi.quantity / ot.total) AS amount
  FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
  JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY 1) ot ON ot.order_id = o.id
  WHERE r.refunded_at >= '2026-04-01' AND r.refunded_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT g.category, to_char(g.q, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS quarter, ROUND(g.amount - COALESCE(f.amount, 0), 0) AS net_revenue
FROM gross g LEFT JOIN refunded f USING (category, q)
ORDER BY 1, 2
